text:
Gold Price in 2010
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2010, the LBMA gold price rose 30.3% between 2010-01-29 ($1,079) and 2010-12-30 ($1,406). The highest sampled price was $1,406 in December and the lowest was $1,079 in January. The mean of these observations was $1,233. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
